scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web "pnpm --dir backend dev" "pnpm --dir apps/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir packages/shared build && pnpm --dir packages/db build && pnpm --dir backend build && pnpm --dir apps/web build && pnpm --dir apps/bot build
scripts.clean: pnpm --dir packages/shared clean && pnpm --dir packages/db clean && pnpm --dir backend clean && pnpm --dir apps/web clean && pnpm --dir apps/bot clean
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/shared typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/db typecheck && pnpm --dir backend typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/bot typecheck
